data.spec: Root fixes live food planner prompt and error semantics in apps/procurement/office_procurement/food.py + apps/agent/office/oda_food.py. Ordinary unspecified package sizes may use a normal economical retail pack; explicit package/diet/allergen constraints still validated. Provider/selection failures raise sanitized FoodPlanningError and stage failed, never fake a user-clarification/pack-size request. Malformed/unavailable product snapshots remain fail-closed with no executable proposal. No basket approval/cart execution changes.
